description: Computes RSI(14), SMA(20/50/200), EMA(12/26), MACD(12,26,9), Bollinger(20,2), ATR(14) and realised volatility from live candles, then summarises trend and momentum into one signal. 0.01 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.
